question: 在主流程（Mainstream）中，完成单元测试（Unit Testing）之后、部署到预发布环境（Deploy to Staging Environment）之前，必须经过哪一步？
options: A. 构建 (Build)
B. 部署到测试环境 (Deploy to Test Environment)
C. 自动化功能测试 (Automated Functional Testing in Test Environment)
D. 部署到生产环境 (Deploy to Production Environment)

question: 以下哪个环节不是在预发布环境（Staging Environment）中进行的？
options: A. 部署 (Deploy)

D. Build -> Unit Testing -> Deploy to Test Environment -> Automated Functional Testing in Test Environment -> Automated Functional Testing in Staging Environment -> Deploy to Production Environment -> Automated Functional Testing in Production Environment
